title: Sufficient Vacancies in Primary Schools Given New HDB BTO Projects in Yishun
what_it_is: Sufficient Vacancies in Primary Schools Given New HDB BTO Projects in Yishun

sections.label: Primary school places in Yishun
sections.summary: MOE projects a slight increase in Primary school demand in Yishun and has introduced measures, including more school places, to meet it.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Due to the families that are moving into the HDB BTO flats in Yishun that were completed in recent years, we have projected a slight increase in the demand for Primary school places at all levels.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: To cater for this increase, we have introduced several measures, including increasing the number of available school places in some of the schools in certain years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: There should be sufficient Primary school places to meet the increased demand from these families.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Parents can participate in the annual Student Transfer Exercise for Primary Schools (STEPS) conducted around November each year, which serves to facilitate the transfer of students who have relocated to another address, to schools nearer to their new residences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Alternatively, parents can approach their child's current school and submit their request for school transfer.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: However, the Member may wish to note that for transfer cases, parents may sometimes not get the school of their choice due to the lack of available vacancies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: MOE cannot keep increasing the intake of particular schools beyond the capacity of the school as it would affect the learning environment of all students.

sections.label: Schools near Yishun BTO estates
sections.summary: These schools have places for most levels, and Ahmad Ibrahim, Xishan and Yishun Primary are within three kilometres of the new BTO estates.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In these schools, there are school places for the majority of all levels.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: There are a few other schools that are close to the planned BTO development that have available places, for example, Ahmad Ibrahim Primary, Xishan Primary as well as Yishun Primary, which are all within three kilometres from the new BTO estates.

sections.label: Commitment to facilitate school transfers
sections.summary: MOE says it is committed and will do its best to place and facilitate the transfer of all children when parents request it.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: At the end of the day, I want to assure the Member that we are very committed and we will do our best to place and facilitate the transfer of all the children when their parents make the request.
